result.summary: Mehtab Agro Foods currently has two open overdue notifications across both its policies (64 DPD on TCI-SCF-2026-0001, exposure INR 4.2M; 41 DPD on TCI-WT-2026-0002, exposure INR 1.8M), with additional NOT_YET_DUE exposure building behind each. This follows a prior resolved invoice that was already 18 days late, and notification frequency has doubled (2 in the last 6 months from 2 policies vs 1 previously), indicating worsening payment discipline rather than an isolated incident. Given combined open exposure of INR 6M against combined credit limits of INR 23M, underwriters should consider tightening terms or increasing monitoring frequency on both policies.
